name: Sass
description: Automatically compile SCSS and Sass files after saving.

children.title: Compile on Save
children.description: Compile local SCSS and Sass files after saving in this project. Sass: Compile Now remains available when Off.

children.title: CSS Style
children.description: Controls the output style of the resulting CSS.

children.title: Generate Source Map
children.description: Source maps are files that tell browsers or other tools that consume CSS how that CSS corresponds to the Sass files from which it was generated. They make it possible to see and even edit your Sass files in browsers.

children.title: Remove UTF-8 BOM
children.description: Remove the UTF-8 byte order mark from CSS generated by successful compilations. Off leaves Sass output unchanged. Applies to newly compiled files only; does not remove @charset declarations.

children.title: Error CSS
children.description: Tells Sass whether to emit a CSS file when an error occurs during compilation.

children.title: Deprecation Warnings
children.description: Show Sass deprecations in the Issues sidebar and editor. Errors and other warnings remain visible. Full diagnostics are always logged to the Extension Console.

configWorkspace.title: Paths
configWorkspace.description: Leave both paths blank for automatic compilation: use the saved file's folder, or its parent when the folder is named scss (so css/scss uses css). Generated CSS is placed beside each Sass entry point. Custom paths start from the project root unless relative paths are enabled below.

children.title: Update Path
children.description: Optional file or folder to compile instead of the automatic scope.

children.title: Output Path
children.description: Optional output folder, or a CSS filename when Update Path targets a single file.
children.placeholder: Automatic: beside each Sass entry point

children.title: Resolve Paths Relative to Sass File
children.description: Resolve custom Update Path and Output Path values from the saved Sass file's folder instead of the project root. Blank paths keep the automatic behaviour above.

children.title: Sass Executable
children.description: Select a detected Sass installation or enter a custom executable path.

children.title: Check Sass Installation
children.description: Verify the selected or automatically detected Sass executable and display its version.
